title: 両手ハンドル付きの穴掘りオーガー
description: 公園の植栽や庭園整備の場面に置く直立姿勢の穴掘り機。左右の開口ハンドル、駆動ヘッド外装と丸い減速部、固定ピン付き継手、一本の連続らせん刃と先端を造形しています。地面・土・電池・内部駆動部は含まず、掘削・回転動作・荷重性能・安全認証はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.856 × 1.206 × 0.360 m、12,126三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An upright earth-auger prop for planting and garden-maintenance scenes, with open left/right handles, drive-head exterior and round gearbox, pinned coupling, one continuous helical ground bit and pilot tip. Ground, soil, battery and working internals are omitted; no drilling, rotation behavior, load performance or safety certification is supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.856 × 1.206 × 0.360 m; 12,126 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
